description: Use when preparing for Japan's Administrative Scrivener examination (行政書士試験) — the absolute passing criteria with separate minimums, administrative law and Civil Code as the core, the 40-character descriptive questions, the basic-knowledge section, studying statutes and Supreme Court precedents from primary sources, and drilling past questions. Also use when writing or verifying practice questions based on administrative law, the Civil Code, the Constitution or commercial law.
